capture.zh: 在云霄星最高处挑战提亚斯，打败获得提亚斯精元（孵化得米拉美）；若它用了两次精神干涉就会自动逃跑，本次不算胜利。

strategy_notes.zh: 35+级波克尔同生共死后换45-50级烈焰猩猩收尾；或100级精灵大招速攻，在它第二次精神干涉之前解决；必中技能可以无视命中下降。

engine_notes: flee_after_skill {skill 20082 精神干涉, count 2}: on the second successful use of 精神干涉 the boss leaves; the battle ends as a failure (lose: boss_fled).
打它容易MISS: explained by 精神干涉 itself (foe accuracy -2 per use); no extra evasion rule added.
它却容易致命一击: crit_rate_up +2 stages at battle start (magnitude is an estimate).
HP never published; 500 is an estimate.
skills: all four are named by a period guide (4399 2010-06-05) and equal species 69's last four at or below Lv45; 精神同步 (Lv46) is above the boss level.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
source_note: 4399 BOSS series (2010-06-05): 云霄星最高处 45级; 「打它容易MISS，它却容易致命一击，只要它两次精神干涉就自动逃跑」.
